summary: CopperTrail is running an evaluation POC for agent-assist + automated summarization. Primary constraints: citation provenance, freshness (24-72h SLA for KB), multi-source retrieval across ticketing, docs, transcripts, and CRM. Requires predictable behavior during spikes and an on-prem/VPC option for select enterprise customers.
kb_requirements: RAG specifics: need multi-index retrieval (tickets + Confluence + transcripts) with per-result citation tokens and origin types, freshness window configurable per source (tickets: 24h, SOPs: 7d, transcripts: 48h), canonicalization pipeline to deduplicate identical answers from different sources, automated source ranking and reranking signals (recentness, trust_score, document_type), snippet-level anchors linking back to ticket IDs. Also require configurable citation formats (URL, ticket-id, excerpt), deterministic fallback chain (primary model -> smaller quantized model -> cached canned responses) and autoscaling policies for spike windows; audit log of retrieval decisions for compliance.
